title: ProCA: Progressive Contrastive Alignment for Robust EEG Visual Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2609.05094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalogram (EEG) visual decoding aims to recover visual semantics from non-invasive neural time-series signals, for which robust alignment between noisy neural responses and stable semantic representations is key to achieving high-performance decoding. Despite recent advances in contrastive learning, robust EEG decoding remains challenging because existing methods rely on fixed visual or textual anchors whose semantic relations may become misaligned with EEG representations that vary across trials, subjects, and learning stages. Our empirical evidence shows that this instability appears across both standard EEG decoding protocols and more challenging robustness settings, including strict cross-subject transfer and realistic personalized continual adaptation. translated_title: ProCA：面向鲁棒脑电视觉解码的渐进式对比对齐
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）视觉解码旨在从非侵入式神经时间序列信号中恢复视觉语义，其中噪声神经响应与稳定语义表示之间的鲁棒对齐是实现高性能解码的关键。尽管对比学习近年来取得了进展，鲁棒的EEG解码仍然具有挑战性，因为现有方法依赖于固定的视觉或文本锚点，其语义关系可能与随试验、被试和学习阶段变化而变化的EEG表示产生失配。我们的实证证据表明，这种不稳定性不仅出现在标准EEG解码协议中，也出现在更具挑战性的鲁棒性设置中，包括严格的跨被试迁移和现实的个性化持续适应。我们提供了形式化分析，表明当EEG特定关系发生演变时，固定语义监督可能会使优化产生偏差，且结构无关的扰动可能……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出ProCA方法，通过渐进式对比对齐解决固定语义锚点与动态演变的EEG表示之间的失配问题，从而在跨被试迁移和个性化持续适应等挑战性场景下实现鲁棒的脑电视觉解码。
en_tdlr: ProCA introduces progressive contrastive alignment to overcome the misalignment between fixed semantic anchors and evolving EEG representations, enabling robust EEG visual decoding under challenging settings such as strict cross-subject transfer and personalized continual adaptation.
